x: It was quite a tonic to see him loping along uphill and down dale to record 28:35 which was a new Club record and a time beaten only by Internationals of such class as Kilby(Coventry) Bullivant (Derby) Craig (Blackpool) Freary (Bolton) and Tulloh (Portsmouth).

Trevor Hart ran the third stage for the A team and widened the gap over the Manchester club to about 80 seconds but Bolton United who had had a bad start had moved into 3rd place with a fast run by Freary who with 21:53 put up a new record for the course.

With only four stages to run, and Hill and Freary in terrific form, it soon became a race for second and North Staffs got us by 17 seconds. The two Bolton stars were each 39 seconds faster than the North brothers---truly fantastic.
No, he's not winning! But he is running a fine race ahead of Freary, Hill, Plain and Jackson in the National Championships. GERRY NORTH eventually finished 17th.
